title: Automated Linux enumeration
description: Colour-coded local privesc checks. Red/yellow highlights are the highest-value findings.
output: Sections for SUID, cron, capabilities, creds. Focus on the 95%-probability hits.

title: Hunt SUID binaries
description: Lists setuid binaries. Cross-reference anything unusual against GTFOBins.
output: Full paths of SUID files. A non-standard one is often the escalation path.

title: Check sudo rights
description: Shows what the current user may run as another user. Match entries to GTFOBins.
output: Allowed commands. NOPASSWD entries and editors/interpreters are prime targets.

title: Find file capabilities
description: Capabilities can grant privilege without SUID. cap_setuid on an interpreter is a win.
output: Files with capabilities set. cap_setuid+ep is the one to look for.

title: Suggest kernel exploits
description: Compares the running kernel/OS against known local privesc CVEs and suggests matching exploits. Download the .sh from the repo and run it on the target. https://github.com/The-Z-Labs/linux-exploit-suggester
output: A ranked list of candidate kernel exploits for this host.
